dish.title: Ginger-Glazed Tempeh with Broccolini
dish.description: Sliced tempeh pan-seared then glazed with ginger, garlic, tamari, and maple, plated with blistered broccolini and rice. No peanut.

recipe_version.title: Ginger-Glazed Tempeh with Broccolini
recipe_version.description: Sliced tempeh pan-seared then glazed with ginger, garlic, tamari, and maple, plated with blistered broccolini and rice. No peanut.

ingredients.name: tempeh
ingredients.note: two 8-oz blocks. Soy allergen. Slice into 1/2-inch slabs after steaming optional step.

ingredients.name: tamari
ingredients.note: HARD SOY CONTRACT for glaze. Tamari so wheat is not introduced. All of it goes into the glaze. Soy allergen.

ingredients.name: maple syrup
ingredients.note: for the glaze. Not pancake syrup with butter flavoring.

ingredients.name: rice vinegar
ingredients.note: unseasoned. Confirm no wheat if labeled seasoned.

ingredients.name: toasted sesame oil
ingredients.note: OPTIONAL finish only. If used, sesame becomes an allergen — this written package omits sesame from the required list by leaving this optional and defaulting off for HH001 simplicity. Prefer skipping unless household wants sesame.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: divided: 2 tbsp for tempeh, 1 tbsp for broccolini

ingredients.name: broccolini
ingredients.preparation: ends trimmed; thick stems halved lengthwise

ingredients.name: cooked rice
ingredients.note: about 3/4 cup cooked rice per serving; cook separately while tempeh glazes

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: to loosen the glaze in the pan

steps.title: Prep tempeh, glaze, and vegetables
steps.body: Slice the tempeh into 1/2-inch slabs. Optional but helpful: steam the slabs 8 minutes to mellow bitterness, then pat dry — if you steam, that time is inside prep. Whisk the tamari, maple syrup, grated ginger, minced garlic, rice vinegar, and 2 tbsp water into a glaze. Trim the broccolini. Slice the scallions. Confirm cooked rice is ready or start it now. HARD PEANUT CONTRACT: do not add peanut butter, peanut oil, or crushed peanuts.

steps.title: Sear the tempeh
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp neutral oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat. Add tempeh slabs in a single layer. Cook until deep golden on the first side, about 3 to 4 minutes. Flip. Cook the second side until golden, about 3 minutes more. Transfer tempeh to a plate.

steps.title: Blister the broccolini
steps.body: Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil to the same skillet over medium-high heat. Add broccolini, kosher salt, and black pepper. Cook, tossing, until stems are tender-crisp and florets blister in spots, about 5 to 6 minutes. Transfer broccolini to the plate with tempeh (or a warm platter).

steps.title: Glaze and plate
steps.body: Reduce heat to medium. Pour the glaze into the skillet. Simmer until slightly syrupy, about 1 to 2 minutes. Return tempeh to the pan and turn to coat, about 1 minute. Optional: drizzle 1 tsp toasted sesame oil off heat only if the household wants sesame — default is skip so sesame stays off the allergen array. Plate rice, broccolini, and glazed tempeh. Scatter scallions. No peanut garnish. kitchen_tested is false.

equipment: mixing bowl or measuring cup for glaze
recipe_version.heat: Medium for tempeh sear; medium-high for broccolini; medium for glaze. No oven required.
recipe_version.doneness: Tempeh deep golden and coated in syrupy ginger-maple glaze. Broccolini tender-crisp with blistered tips. Rice hot. kitchen_tested is false.
